name: XA Chorus
description: 22.05 kHz 3-voice stereo modulation chorus with 16-bit saturation and warm low-pass rolloff.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: PS1 chorus voicing (DUAL = 2-voice stereo, TRIO = 3-voice ensemble, NEGV = SPU negative-volume wide stereo, VBLNK = 60Hz stepped pitch LFO).

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: Modulation speed (0.1..5.5 Hz, then 1/32..1/2 synced to pedal BPM).

params.name: Delay
params.explanation: Base voice delay offset (4..24 ms; tight doubler to wide ensemble).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: PS1 4-point Gaussian interpolation darkening (0 = bright, 100 = warm hazy 90s ROMpler).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/Wet blend (0 = dry, 50 = classic chorus, 100 = 100% wet vibrato/ensemble).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
